segments.text: ALmyghtye God, whiche through thy onely begotten ſonne Ieſus Chriſte, haſte ouercome deathe, and opened vnto vs the gate of euerlaſting life: we humbly beſeche thee, that as by thy ſpeciall grace, preuentyng vs, thou doeſt putte in oure myndes good deſyres: ſo by thy continuall helpe, we may bring theſame to good effect, through Ieſus Chriſte our Lorde: who lyueth and reygneth. &c.
